name: Jessica Jane Has Acne
source:
Jessica Jane has acne, due to this her confidence has suffered greatly and she's not sure what to do with herself. Her life has been stagnant ever since leaving school and the days have started to blur together. All seems hopeless, the day goes on like any other, until... somebody unexpected gives her a call. Could this be the wake up call she needs?

[from [url=https://starsauce.itch.io/jessica-jane-has-acne]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
杰西卡·简（Jessica Jane）长了痤疮，因此她的信心受到了很大的打击，她不知道该怎么办。自从离开学校之后，她的生活就停滞不前，日子也开始变得模糊起来。一切似乎都毫无希望，日子一如既往地过着，直到……某个意想不到的人给她打了电话。难道这就是她需要的警钟吗？

[来自[url=https://starsauce.itch.io/jessica-jane-has-acne]itch.io[/url]]
